title: Trust Ops scratch journal — SOC2 prep
content:
Purpose: quick running log for my SOC2 control mapping + evidence hunt. Working notes, half-formed ideas, and action items. Not ready for sharing — meant for iteration and handoff later.

High-level scope / assumptions:
- In-scope services: hosted API (public endpoints), Dedicated control plane, Private deployments control plane only. Data-plane for Private is customer-managed (out of scope for our default evidence).
- Timebox: align to upcoming readiness review (internal) on 2026-03-18. External auditor kickoff targeted for 2026-04-12.

Quick wins (low effort, high value):
- Snapshot: enable daily CloudTrail logs export to an evidence S3 prefix (retain 90 days) — blocker: confirm billing + bucket lifecycle.
- IAM reviews: run the iam-pruner script for service accounts used by staging; capture pre/post diff as evidence.
- KMS policy doc: consolidate KMS key usage table (who can decrypt, CMK vs customer keys).

Evidence inventory (initial pass):
- Identity & Access Management:
  - console-auth-events.csv (login logs) — generated by ops, location: s3://redwood-evidence/iam/logins/
  - iam-role-attachments-2026-02-10.txt (manual export)
- Change management:
  - github PRs: infra/pull/412 (autoscaler tweak) — need approval chain screenshot
  - jira JIRA-ENG-901 change ticket (deploy window)
- Logging & monitoring:
  - datadog-alert-history-2026-02-xx (export)
  - prometheus-rule-changes.md (manual notes)
- Encryption:
  - kms-key-usage.csv (last 12 mo)
  - disk-encryption-policy-v1.docx
- Business continuity / backups:
  - backup-verification-runbook.md (draft)
  - s3-backup-reports/2026-01-*/success.csv

Control mapping rough notes (control id -> artifact ideas):
- CC1 (logical access): map to: iam-role-attachments, console-auth-events, access-review-runbook.md
- CC2 (change control): github PR approvals, jira ticket, deployment runbook snapshot, canary rollback logs
- CC3 (system operations): datadog alert history, incident postmortems (redacted), SRE runbook versions
- CC4 (encryption & key mgmt): kms-key-usage, KMS IAM policy, key rotation log (TODO: find rotation log)

Open questions / unknowns (need to resolve before 3/18):
- Rotation evidence: where is automated key rotation logged? Cloud provider only, or do we have a rotation operation log? Owner: Ellie.
- Private deployment footprint: auditors will want to see controls for Private control plane — confirm which evidence we can collect from customer-managed data planes. Owner: Maya.
- MFA enforcement for service principals: we currently require MFA for user logins, but not for machine identities; document rationale and mitigating controls. Owner: Noah.
- Retention windows: decide standard retention baseline for SOC2 evidence artifacts (90 vs 180 days). Ops lead to confirm cost impact.

Risks / mitigations brainstorm:
- Risk: noisy alerts causing missed true positives. Mitigation: run a suppression audit and identify top 10 noisy rules; schedule a tuning sprint.
- Risk: incomplete change history for hotfixes pushed directly to prod. Mitigation: enforce post-facto change ticket policy + require rollback playbook.
- Risk: lack of separation for build deploy pipeline. Mitigation: add codeowners + sign-off requirements for production releases.

Action items (next 2 weeks):
- [ ] Export last 6 months of CloudTrail to evidence bucket and attach lifecycle policy. (Owner: Harper)
- [ ] Locate KMS rotation logs or open a ticket to instrument rotation events to CloudWatch/Logging. (Owner: Ellie)
- [ ] Produce a sample evidence packet for CC2 (change control): PR + Jira + deploy logs + approval screenshot. (Owner: Noah)
- [ ] Draft a short note on Private deployment evidence boundaries to hand to Solutions Eng for customer-facing guidance. (Owner: Maya)

Hand-off notes for audit prep deck:
- Keep examples redacted (no customer data). For each control example include: 1) artifact file name, 2) owner, 3) timestamp, 4) explanation of trustworthiness (how generated / why reliable).
- Be explicit about what we do vs what customers do in Private deployments.

Random ideas worth capturing:
- Could we produce a small 'SOC2 evidence CLI' that zips up named artifacts and spits out a markdown manifest? Low priority but would reduce human error.
- Add a metadata header to exported artifacts (json blob with generated_by, generated_at, source_commit). Makes auditor life easier.

Notes to self / TODO later:
- Revisit the incident postmortem redaction checklist. Need consistent template.
- Ask legal for recommended wording on customer attestations for Private deployments.
- Schedule a dry run with an internal auditor on 2026-03-11 (one week before internal review).

Timestamped log of changes (quick):
- 2026-02-15: initial sketch; listed evidence buckets and quick wins.
- 2026-02-22: added changelog artifacts (PR link), found CloudTrail export.
- 2026-03-02: met with SRE — noted need for backup verification runbook updates.
- 2026-03-09: updated action items and clarified owners.

End of page. Will iterate and convert messy bits into a tidy HLD for the reviewer once we have the rotation log and CloudTrail export confirmed.

(Notes deliberately informal: meant to be a working journal. If I stop editing, handoff to Maya with a 30-min sync.)
